# 591. Tag Validator

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def isValid(self, code):
        """
        :type code: str
        :rtype: bool
        """
        s = []
        n = len(code)
        p = 0
        while p < n:
            if p > 0 and not s:
                return False
            if code[p: p + 9] == "<![CDATA[":
                t = p + 9
                p = code.find("]]>", t)
                if p < 0:
                    return False
                p += 3
            elif code[p: p + 2] == "</":
                t = p + 2
                p = code.find(">", t)
                if p < 0:
                    return False
                tag = code[t: p]
                if not s or s[-1] != tag:
                    return False
                s.pop()
                p += 1
            elif code[p] == "<":
                t = p + 1
                p = code.find(">", t)
                if p < 0:
                    return False
                tag = code[t: p]
                if not 1 <= len(tag) <= 9:
                    return False
                if not all(c.isupper() for c in tag):
                    return False
                s.append(tag)
                p += 1
            else:
                p += 1
        return not s
```
